questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “the largest reserves of table salt in Uzbekistan” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formulada “O‘zbekistondagi osh tuzining eng katta zaxiralari” shu kabi fikrlardan aniqroq ajratilgan?
choicesEn: Only in the Kyzylkum desert without connection with the sea
choicesUz: Faqat Qizilqum cho'lida dengiz bilan bog'lanmagan
explanationEn: Salt reserves are located along the Aral Sea.
explanationUz: Tuz zahiralari Orol dengizi boʻyida joylashgan.
